name: Cao Bang to Ha Giang
summary: Drive or ride west through Bao Lac, then on National Highway 34 to Ha Giang. It is mountain road with no rail or air option, so plan to ride in daylight.

modes.note: From Bảo Lạc it is 125 km west on QL34 to Hà Giang. That stretch follows the Gâm River, with twists and a few passes. Ride in daylight and stop after dark.

seoTitle: Cao Bang to Ha Giang — the road through Bao Lac
seoDescription: Cao Bang to Ha Giang is a mountain road west through Bao Lac and National Highway 34, with no train or flight.

faqs.a: Ask in Cao Bằng for the current service.

faqs.q: Does this road join the Ha Giang loop?
faqs.a: Yes. The loop’s last stretch runs from Bảo Lạc west on QL34 to Hà Giang, so this road meets it at Bảo Lạc.
